title: Chapter 4: Trial of the Chosen One

image.alt: Trial of the Chosen One chapter art

paragraphs: 夜裡，被喜利・歐喜利驚醒的薩梅爾發現喜利・歐喜利正在塗鴉大家的臉，並成功說服他放過自己和酷爆。不過此時的他已經睡飽了，因此將酷爆放回帳篷後，便到處繞了繞。
薩梅爾找到一個賣樂器的攤位，試著和店家溝通後，試彈了一把魯特琴，音色明顯比英荻格以前送他的那把更好。他向店家提起英荻格，店家便把她找了過來。得知薩梅爾想買這把琴，英荻格得意地借了支筆，在琴上簽下自己的名字。接著，應薩梅爾的要求，她又給了他一顆似乎帶有簽名印記的寶石，表示買東西時只要出示寶石，讓店家感應一下，帳就會記在她名下。

paragraphs.quote:
「之前有暗影之父，現在有阿嬤支付。」
地下城主(!?)

paragraphs: 接著，薩梅爾在樂器攤翻了許久，找到了一把神奇的樂器。他曾聽說過迪吉里杜管，但這是他第一次見到，大小比他認知中的小了很多，長度還不到他身高的一半。試吹了一下後，薩梅爾便決定要買了。帶著兩把新的樂器，薩梅爾心滿意足地回到了帳篷去。此時除了喜利・歐喜利外，大家都睡飽了。大家便把喜利・歐喜利叫醒，準備參與今天最重要的事：那場屬於米多莉和波的試煉。然而，當大家準備出發時，薩梅爾卻發現龍恩不見了。
猶豫著該不該先去把龍恩找出來，大家最終決定先去找艾爾比，龍恩也許先跑去試煉場了也說不定。在居民的帶路下，大家見到站在中心樹邊的艾爾比，與平日穿著純白的衣服不同，今天的她，換上了全黑的裝扮。米多莉詢問艾爾比能否先吃個早餐，但艾爾比表示是時候進行試煉了。
在艾爾比的呼喚下，帳篷內的居民們通通向中心樹靠了過來。艾爾比念起咒語，突然間，地面開始震動，中心樹陡然向上拔起，露出了一個巨大的樹洞。艾爾比帶頭走入樹洞，居民們也隨後跟上，冒險者們則走在最後。樹洞內是向下盤旋的樓梯，一路向下通往帳篷底下巨大的廣場。
踏出樹洞內的樓梯，居民們紛紛繞到廣場的邊緣，把中間留給艾爾比和參與試煉的米多莉與波。艾爾比一面以仙靈語向居民們宣佈試煉即將開始，一面向米多莉與波簡單說明，每次試煉都會有不同人負責主持，且試煉的內容也不一樣。這一次將有五個試煉，考驗兩人的各種能力。
第一項是奉獻試煉，兩人必須各自獻出一樣屬於自己的東西。波拿起小刀，割下長髮，分送給廣場周圍的居民，最後留下一根遞給米多莉。她用普通語告訴大家，雖然自己來這裡不久，仍希望能成為這個群體的一分子，就像大家現在各自保有她的一部分一樣。輪到米多莉時，她唱起〈真正的朋友〉，將歌曲獻給居民，希望成為大家的朋友。

第二項是感官試煉。艾爾比請三名居民各拿一個不透光的箱子上前，接著從口袋取出一根潔白的羽毛，中間帶著幾簇黑色羽枝。她說，這根羽毛曾被先祖「征服者洛林」親吻過，兩人要找出它藏在哪個箱子裡。她將羽毛拋向空中，再伸手接住時，羽毛便消失了。這回米多莉先開始，她試著感應，排除其中一個箱子，再次感知後找出了正確的箱子。艾爾比幫她取出羽毛。米多莉握著羽毛，哼起曾聽過的〈洛林精神〉，居民之間也彷彿響起輕輕附和的旋律。接著，波坐下、閉起雙眼，讓雙手在三個箱子之間移動。幾分鐘後，她做出決定，將手伸進其中一個箱子，從眾多羽毛裡取出被洛林親吻過的那根。

第三項是預見試煉。艾爾比請兩人透過中心樹，看見妖精荒野的未來，並與居民分享。波先背靠著樹，雙手觸碰樹皮，緩緩呼吸。不久後，她站起身，大聲告訴居民：不論誰成為救世主，妖精荒野都會持續繁榮、和平、穩定數千數萬年，大帳篷甚至會不斷向外擴展，消除外頭的危險。輪到米多莉時，她伸手碰觸樹幹，卻只在黑暗中看見小雪的身影。穿著簡樸的小雪似乎說著什麼，但米多莉聽不見，只能仔細讀她的唇語。小雪說自己感覺快要消失了，請米多莉放她自由；只要米多莉還牽掛著她，她就無法離開。米多莉試著與她對話，卻沒得到太多有用的訊息。她暫時移開手，再次連結中心樹，畫面中依然只有小雪。小雪向她道別，隨即消失。米多莉心慌意亂，再試了一次。這回，她看見有人從外面竄入妖精荒野的大帳篷，後方跟著大批人群，接著帳篷內的燭火全都熄滅了。帶頭那人，竟有著小雪的臉。米多莉向艾爾比說明，懷疑自己並沒有看見妖精荒野的未來；艾爾比則表示，這些資訊已經很有幫助。

第四項是決心試煉，兩人必須分別攻擊對自己最重要的人。米多莉說自己沒帶武器，艾爾比便向居民替她要了一根木棍。這回由米多莉先開始，波被帶到樹的另一側。艾爾比施法，幻化出跪在地上的小雪。即使剛才已透過中心樹見過她，米多莉依然深受影響，試著與她對話，最終卻下不了手，只能請艾爾比解除幻象。輪到波時，米多莉被帶到樹後方，而波眼前出現的，正是米多莉。波一開始也十分震驚，但認定那只是幻象後，便揮出一拳，將幻影打散。

最後一項是力量試煉。艾爾比請兩人同時用最大的力氣朝著中心樹攻擊，目標是將中心樹打斷。對於這樣的要求，米多莉感到有些困惑，畢竟中心樹是這裡的骨幹，裡面還承載著所有人的知識與記憶，這樣的行為十分古怪。艾爾比表示不用擔心，這只是試煉的一部分而已。半信半疑之下，米多莉和波便開始攻擊中心樹。見到中心樹被攻擊，居民們感到慌張與困惑，試圖衝到廣場中心進行阻撓，但艾爾比突然間在樹的周圍設起了一道藍色的屏障，將中心樹、自己、米多莉和波與其他人區隔開來，同時，她自己也開始使用魔法朝著中心樹攻擊。
廣場周圍的群眾全部都繞到屏障周圍了，但是只要身體距離屏障太過接近，就會被彈開來，根本無法介入。薩梅爾試著尋找英荻格阿嬤，並將英荻格帶到大家身邊，討論該怎麼做。由於根本無法進入屏障，大家最終只得到一個結論：先穿越回物質世界，再穿越回到帳篷的上層，從上方進行干預。於是在英荻格的帶領下，薩梅爾、YHWH和法朗茲穿越回了物質世界，留下待在妖精荒野的喜利・歐喜利隨時監控著米多莉和波的狀況。

回到物質世界，多侖維爾的天氣已經開始熱起來了。薩梅爾走進之前住過的酒館，向老闆詢問白醫師之前都住在什麼地方。老闆帶著大家，繞到了一座農田旁的小屋，裡面空蕩蕩的，就像不曾有人住過一樣。大家對這個房間檢查了一遍，YHWH發現床底板似乎有兩個像拉索斯語的印記，請法朗茲幫忙確認。大家這才意識到艾爾比很可能一直都是拉索斯教的人。薩梅爾問英荻格，先前提到在妖精荒野被捕的拉索斯教信徒，究竟是怎麼回事。於是英荻格便準備開始分享。然而，此時YHWH和法朗茲突然對於英荻格是誰感到困惑。在英荻格的說明下，薩梅爾才了解到，妖精以外的生物在回到物質世界後會有記憶消失的現象，所以兩人才會完全不記得在妖精荒野認識的英荻格。薩梅爾也趕緊簡單向YHWH和法朗茲說明米多莉和波現在遇到危險了，大家得趕快想好解決辦法，回到妖精荒野拯救他們。
在英荻格的說明下，大家了解到妖精荒野曾抓到的拉索斯教徒，似乎來回於兩個世界很多次，將妖精荒野的知識與物品帶給了拉索斯教，但是他被關押在什麼地方還是沒有得到答案。
在薩梅爾等人回到物質世界的短短時間內，中心樹已經快要倒了。一瞬間，艾爾比將手搭在波肩上。米多莉見狀，趕緊透過法術，將艾爾比施放的法術轉移到自己身上，米多莉與艾爾比一同消失，樹外的屏障也隨之解除，只留下波。原本圍繞在屏障外的居民們紛紛衝向樹邊，試著攀上樹，想爬回地面去。波和喜利・歐喜利相聚，喜利・歐喜利從自己的背包拿出網子，打算稍後將網子向上拋，勾在樹上，讓波可以藉此爬回地面去。
在一片虛無中，米多莉發現自己和艾爾比懸浮著。艾爾比捲起袖子後，露出的手臂上滿是拉索斯的經文。米多莉踩住艾爾比，用手中的木棍狠狠砸向她的臉。準備砸下第二擊時，小雪的臉出現在眼前，但米多莉還是狠下心打了下去。第三擊落下後，艾爾比便一動也不動了。
好一段時間後，米多莉聽見了遠方傳來的步伐聲。她小心翼翼地沿著與腳步聲平行的方向前進，走了一段時間後，發現步伐聲消失了。米多莉朝著那方向前進，卻失去了方向感。她試著向津菈祈禱，身體便開始漂浮，然後終於停了下來。雖然眼前依然一片漆黑，米多莉似乎摸到了周圍像是簾幕一般的構造。好奇之下，她點起了火把，將火把朝簾幕外伸了出去——
英荻格試著將大家從物質世界傳送回到妖精荒野，但因為不久前才剛穿越過，體力已經不足，因此這個重責大任便落到了薩梅爾身上。在極度專注下，薩梅爾順利的將大家傳送回到了妖精荒野帳篷的上層，但大家卻發現上層的帳篷一片漆黑，薩梅爾甚至發現周圍有大量不屬於帳篷居民的氣息。YHWH趕緊用魔法將上層的中心樹周圍點起營火，但還是看不太清楚。
薩梅爾突然看見帳篷外出現了一小道光，一隻拿著火把的手從帳篷外伸了出來，然後又縮了回去。基於好奇，YHWH跑了過去，將帳篷拉開，外面是漆黑的野外。不過，聽見了YHWH和薩梅爾的說話聲，簾幕另一側的米多莉鼓起勇氣，走了過來，大家便相聚了。
薩梅爾透過幻象，將聲音傳遞到帳篷的下方，得知喜利・歐喜利的計畫，於是從上方接住了喜利・歐喜利的網子，請英荻格坐在網子上，固定住網子。帳篷底下，居民們爭先恐後地想爬上網子，波大聲喊著自己是救世主，自己應該先爬，於是便第一個爬上了網子，上方的冒險者則將她拉到了地面上。接著，居民們紛紛爬了上來，冒險者們則在上方接應。最後剩下極少數的居民時，喜利・歐喜利才爬了上來，他估計這個網子大概下次用一下就會壞了。
當所有居民都被拉了上來後，米多莉和英荻格問了一下這裡是否有什麼領導者，但是似乎除了艾爾比外，沒有人有這樣的領導風範，或許米多莉與波才是現在最能登高一呼的人選。於是，米多莉請英荻格代她翻譯。米多莉告訴居民們艾爾比是拉索斯教的人，她的手臂上刺滿了拉索斯的經文，請大家幫忙確認身邊的夥伴們手上是否有拉索斯的經文。

Awakened by Siri in the night, Samael discovered him drawing on everyone's faces and persuaded him to spare both him and Kubao. Already well rested, Samael put Kubao back in the sleeping area and went for a walk.

At an instrument stall, Samael tried a lute that sounded much better than the one Indigo had given him. When he mentioned her name, the vendor went to fetch her. On learning that he wanted the lute, Indigo proudly borrowed a pen and signed it. At Samael's request, she also gave him a gem that seemed to bear her signature. He could present it when shopping, she explained, and the purchase would be charged to her account.

paragraphs.quote:
"First the Father of Shadows, now the Bank of Grandma."
The Dungeon Master (!?)

paragraphs: After browsing further, Samael found an unusual instrument: a didgeridoo, which he had heard of but never seen. It was much smaller than he expected, less than half his height. He tried it and decided to buy it. Pleased with his two new instruments, he returned to the sleeping area. Everyone except Siri was now well rested, so they woke him and prepared for the day's main event: Midori and Beau's trial. As they were about to leave, however, Samael noticed Ron was missing.

After debating whether to search for Ron, they decided to find Elby first; perhaps he had gone ahead to the trial. A resident guided them to the Center Tree, where Elby stood dressed entirely in black instead of her usual white. Midori asked about breakfast, but Elby said it was time for the trial.

At Elby's call, the residents gathered around the Center Tree. She chanted, the ground shook, and the tree rose abruptly, exposing a huge hollow beneath it. Elby entered first, followed by the residents and then the adventurers. A spiral stairway descended through the hollow into a vast plaza beneath the tent.

The residents moved to the plaza's edges, leaving its center to Elby, Midori, and Beau. In Fey, Elby announced that the trial was beginning. She also explained to the two candidates that each trial had a different host and different tasks. This one would consist of five challenges testing their abilities.

First came the Trial of Giving. Each candidate had to offer the residents something of her own. Beau cut off her long hair with a knife and distributed it around the plaza, saving one strand for Midori. Speaking in Common, she said that although she had only just arrived, she hoped to become part of their community, just as each of them now held a part of her. Midori then dedicated a song, "True True Friend," to the residents, hoping to become their friend.

Next was the Trial of the Senses. Elby had three residents bring opaque boxes, then produced a white feather with a few black barbs. It had been kissed by their ancestor, Lorraine the Conqueror. The candidates had to find which box contained it. Elby tossed it into the air; when she caught it, it vanished. Midori went first, sensing the boxes, eliminating one, and then identifying the right one. Elby helped retrieve the feather. Holding it, Midori hummed "Spirit of Lorraine," and a faint answering melody seemed to rise from the crowd. Beau then sat with her eyes closed, moving her hands between the boxes. After several minutes, she reached into one and selected Lorraine's feather from among many others.

The third challenge was the Trial of Foresight: use the Center Tree to glimpse the Feywild's future and share it with the residents. Beau sat with her back to the tree, touched its bark with both hands, and breathed slowly. She soon rose and announced that, whoever became savior, the Feywild would enjoy peace, prosperity, and stability for countless millennia. The tent would expand until the dangers outside were gone. Midori touched the tree next, but saw only Yuki in the darkness, dressed simply and speaking without a sound. Reading her lips, Midori understood that Yuki felt herself fading and wanted to be set free: as long as Midori clung to her, she could not leave. Midori tried to speak with her but learned little. She broke contact, then tried again. Yuki said goodbye and vanished. Panicking, Midori touched the tree a third time. Now she saw someone rush into the great tent, followed by a large crowd, before all its candles went out. The leader wore Yuki's face. Midori described this to Elby, uncertain whether she had seen the Feywild's future at all. Elby assured her that the information was already very useful.

The fourth challenge, the Trial of Resolve, required each candidate to attack the person most important to her. Since Midori had no weapon, Elby obtained a wooden stick for her. Beau was led behind the tree while Midori went first. Elby conjured an image of Yuki kneeling on the ground. Despite having just seen Yuki through the tree, Midori was deeply shaken. She tried to talk to the image but could not bring herself to strike, and asked Elby to dismiss it. For Beau's turn, Midori was taken out of sight. Elby conjured Midori's image before Beau, who was initially shocked. Once she decided it was only an illusion, however, she punched it, and it disappeared.

Last came the Trial of Strength. Elby told both candidates to strike the Center Tree with all their might until they broke it. Midori was troubled: the tree sustained the community and held everyone's knowledge and memories. Elby told her not to worry; it was simply part of the trial. Still doubtful, Midori joined Beau in attacking the tree. The residents grew alarmed and rushed forward to intervene, but Elby raised a blue barrier around herself, the candidates, and the tree. She then began attacking it with magic herself.

The crowd surrounded the barrier, but anyone who came too close was thrown back. Samael found Indigo and brought her over to discuss a plan. Unable to enter the barrier, they decided to cross to the material world, then return to the tent's upper level and intervene from above. Indigo took Samael, YHWH, and Franz with her, leaving Siri to watch over Midori and Beau.

Back in Dorrenville, the weather had already grown warm. Samael asked the tavern keeper where Dr. White had lived, and he led them to an empty cottage beside a field. It looked as though no one had ever lived there. Searching the room, YHWH found two marks resembling Laxthosian writing beneath the bed and asked Franz to check them. The party realized Elby might have been working for the Laxthos Cult all along. Samael asked Indigo about the cultist once captured in the Feywild, but as she began to explain, YHWH and Franz suddenly became confused about who she was. Indigo explained that non-elven travelers could lose their memories on returning to the material world, including memories of people they had met in the Feywild. Samael quickly reminded them that Midori and Beau were in danger and that they had to return with a rescue plan.

Indigo explained that the captured cultist had apparently crossed between the two worlds many times, carrying the Feywild's knowledge and possessions to the Laxthos Cult. She still did not reveal where the prisoner was held.

During their brief absence, the Center Tree had nearly fallen. Elby suddenly put a hand on Beau's shoulder. Midori redirected the spell onto herself, and both she and Elby vanished, along with the barrier around the tree, leaving Beau behind. The residents rushed forward and tried to climb back to the surface. Beau reunited with Siri, who took a net from his pack, planning to throw it upward and catch it on the tree so she could climb out.

Midori found herself floating with Elby in an empty void. Beneath Elby's rolled-up sleeves, her arms were covered in Laxthos scripture. Bracing herself against Elby, Midori struck her face with the wooden stick. Before the second blow, Yuki's face appeared before her, but she steeled herself and struck again. After the third blow, Elby lay motionless.

Much later, Midori heard distant footsteps. She carefully moved parallel to them until they stopped, then headed toward where they had been and lost her bearings. She prayed to Keinra, began to float, and eventually came to a halt. Though everything was still dark, she felt something like a curtain around her. Curious, she lit a torch and reached it through—

Indigo tried to take the group back to the Feywild, but the recent crossings had left her too exhausted. The task fell to Samael. Concentrating intensely, he transported everyone to the tent's upper level. It was pitch-black, and he sensed many presences that did not belong to the residents. YHWH conjured a bonfire near the Center Tree, but visibility remained poor.

Samael suddenly noticed a sliver of light at the tent's edge: a hand holding a torch reached in from outside, then withdrew. Curious, YHWH ran over and pulled back the canvas, revealing the dark wilderness. On the other side, Midori heard his and Samael's voices, gathered her courage, and stepped through to rejoin them.

Samael used an illusion to send his voice down below and learned Siri's plan. He caught the net from above and had Indigo sit on it to anchor it. Below, the residents scrambled to climb. Beau shouted that she was the savior and should go first, climbed onto the net, and was hauled up by the adventurers. They then pulled the residents up one by one. Siri waited until only a few remained before climbing out himself, judging that the net might survive only one more use.

Once everyone was aboveground, Midori and Indigo asked who could lead the residents. No one seemed to command authority as Elby had; perhaps Midori or Beau was now best placed to rally them. With Indigo translating, Midori explained that Elby had belonged to the Laxthos Cult and had its scripture tattooed on her arms. She asked everyone to check the arms of those around them for similar markings.
